name: config-expression-previews
goal: Show committed regex and computed config expressions inline with ellipsis, preserving structured inspection and source safety.

evidence: Committed regex and expression prefixes stay inline with one-line ellipsis and full-source hover; collections keep their inspector. No config evaluation.

The groups matrix deliberately expected a modal for long computed source and lacked a long regex. Extend its typed fixtures and shared assertions at current and historical revisions across all declared viewports.
